dialogue.text: This hanging board in the middle displays your current daily songs.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: Completed daily songs will grant an additional 50% FunkBucks.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: The daily board resets at midnight according to your local time.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: We don't offer similar bonuses for Weeks,<d=0.25/> but maybe later!
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia
